---
title: "PCA vessels"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# set up matrix

```{r}
# Load best models with vessel as random effect
model_files <- list.files(
  path = "models/",
  pattern = "best_model\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE)

response_names <- gsub("_best_model\\.rds$", "", basename(model_files))

models <- setNames(
  lapply(model_files, readRDS),
  response_names)

# Extract vessel random effects
extract_vessel_effects <- function(model) {
  coefs <- coef(model)
  idx <- grep("^s\\(vessel\\)", names(coefs))
  if (length(idx) > 0) {
    effects <- coefs[idx]
    names(effects) <- sub(
      "^s\\(vessel\\)\\.",
      "",
      names(effects)
    )
    return(effects)
  }
  NULL
}
vessel_effects <- lapply(models, extract_vessel_effects)

# Remove models with no vessel effect (dolphins)
vessel_effects <- vessel_effects[ sapply(vessel_effects, function(x) any(x != 0))]

# Vessel response matrix
vessel_matrix <- do.call(cbind, vessel_effects)

dim(vessel_matrix)
```

## PCA on vessel effect matrix

```{r}
# PCA on vessel-effect matrix
pca <- prcomp(vessel_matrix, scale. = TRUE)

apply(vessel_matrix, 2, sd) %>% sort()
# plot vessels
plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2],  xlab = "PC1",  ylab = "PC2",  pch = 16)
# add species loadings
biplot(pca)
loadings <- data.frame(pca$rotation)
loadings$species <- rownames(loadings)
plot(pca$x[,1], pca$x[,2], pch = 16)
arrows(0, 0, loadings$PC1, loadings$PC2, col = "red", length = 0.1)
text(loadings$PC1, loadings$PC2, labels = loadings$species, col = "red", pos = 3)
```

## k means clustering
```{r}
# pick number of clusters using an elbow plot
wss <- sapply(1:10,
  function(k) {
    kmeans(
      pca$x[, 1:2],
      centers = k,
      nstart = 20
    )$tot.withinss})

plot(1:10, wss, type = "b", xlab = "Number of clusters k", ylab = "Within cluster SS")

# Select k based on the elbow plot
km <- kmeans(pca$x[, 1:2], centers = 3, nstart = 20)

# Visualise clusters
plot(pca$x[, 1:2], col = km$cluster, pch = 19, xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2")
points( km$centers, pch = 8,cex = 2)

# Cluster diagnostics
sil <- silhouette( km$cluster, dist(pca$x[, 1:2]))
plot(sil)

mean(sil[, 3])
```

## scree plot
```{r}

variance_explained <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", seq_along(pca$sdev)),
  Variance = (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2))

ggplot(  variance_explained, aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "grey70") +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Principal component", y = "Proportion of variance explained") +
  theme_bw()
```
